facts.old: Four properties: heavy long-lived requests
facts.where: Reading s1 (It is long, and it streams)
facts.verdict: verified and quantified: 69 tok/s per stream, ~6 s per reply, Little's law 700 to 1,400 open streams

facts.old: Connection-count load balancing fails; balance on in-flight tokens or KV occupancy; least-outstanding-requests floor, KV-aware routing ceiling
facts.verdict: carried with sources: production-stack load-aware formula, llm-d scorers, GIE InferencePool

facts.old: Capacity quantised in GPU replicas with multi-minute cold starts (image pull, weight load, warmup)
facts.where: Reading s1 and s8 cold-start table
facts.verdict: verified: vLLM sleep-mode blog cold-start components, Run:ai, Dynamo 'minutes, not seconds'

facts.old: No scale-to-zero reflexes from serverless CPU land
facts.verdict: refined: KEDA and Knative do support scale to zero; right for internal tools, wrong for chat

facts.old: Outputs nondeterministic; rollout safety from evals and shadow traffic
facts.verdict: verified: Thinking Machines 80 unique completions of 1,000 at temperature 0

facts.old: Unit economics: per-request cost 3-6 orders of magnitude above CRUD
facts.where: Reading s1 cost; One screen table
facts.verdict: confirmed by derivation: 3.6 (self-hosted) to 4.7 (API) orders, about 6 for a 100k-token document; recompute.py

facts.old: Reference architecture: client, gateway, router, realtime pool or batch queue, engine, caches, metering
facts.verdict: carried, extended (autoscaler, rollout control, external providers)

facts.old: Gateway: authN/Z, per-tenant rate limits, validation, idempotency keys, SSE passthrough, provider abstraction, usage events for billing
facts.where: Reading s3 (nine jobs), s11 (idempotency on stream retry)
facts.verdict: carried; Uber GenAI Gateway quotes

facts.old: Open-source gateways: LiteLLM, Envoy AI Gateway, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway
facts.verdict: LiteLLM v1.104.0 and Envoy AI Gateway (renamed Agent Router) v1.1.0 verified; Portkey and Kong named, unconfirmed

facts.old: Router: tier routing via classifier or heuristics, tenant pinning, region/compliance routing, failover across providers
facts.verdict: carried; Huyen quote; prices from snapshot

facts.old: Replica routing cache-aware: SGLang router, llm-d, Dynamo
facts.verdict: llm-d and vLLM production stack verified; SGLang router and Dynamo routing not re-checked, left to Topic: inference-and-serving

facts.old: Batch vs realtime split at gateway; batch for embeddings backfills, evals, synthetic data, doc pipelines; throughput-optimised, spot or off-peak
facts.verdict: carried

facts.old: Batch priced at ~50%, submit a file, poll, 24h window (OpenAI/Anthropic)
facts.verdict: verified both vendors; Anthropic: most finish under 1 h, 100,000 requests or 256 MB

facts.old: Third lane: priority tiers within realtime (flex/standard/priority processing)
facts.verdict: corrected: OpenAI Priority processing renamed Fast mode on 30 Jul 2026; Anthropic Priority Tier no longer sold to new buyers (s6)

facts.old: Autoscale on queue depth, KV utilisation, in-flight requests, token throughput; not CPU
facts.verdict: verified: GKE guide (queue size, batch size; GPU util and memory bad); llm-d KEDA blueprint (waiting 20, KV 0.95); note GKE page does not mention KV

facts.old: KEDA or custom controllers; concurrency-based autoscaling in Knative
facts.where: Reading s8 (KServe KEDA YAML, KEDA defaults, Knative scale to zero)
facts.verdict: verified, versions pinned

facts.old: Cold start: pre-pulled images, weights on NVMe or streamed (Run:ai streamer, safetensors+GDS), warm pools, predictive scaling
facts.where: Reading s8 cold-start table, animation warm pool
facts.verdict: verified Run:ai numbers, GKE image streaming, KServe LocalModelCache, vLLM sleep mode, Dynamo predictive loop; GDS not carried (fastsafetensors used instead)

facts.old: Overprovision headroom is a cost/SLO dial
facts.verdict: carried

facts.old: Exact-match cache: hash(model, prompt, params); low hit rate except system prompts and retry dedup
facts.verdict: carried; tenant added to key

facts.old: Semantic cache: embed, ANN search, threshold (GPTCache); dangerous for personalised/time-sensitive; threshold tuning as eval problem; scope per tenant
facts.verdict: verified with numbers: GPT Semantic Cache ~97% correct hits, vCache 12.5x/26x, GPTCache false-positive warning, Huyen verdict

facts.old: Prefix/KV cache reuse: RadixAttention, vLLM prefix caching, KV offload LMCache, Dynamo; static content as true prefix
facts.verdict: carried; RadixAttention, LMCache, Dynamo offload left to Topic: inference-and-serving

facts.old: Provider prompt caching: explicit breakpoints Anthropic, automatic OpenAI; changes prompt-assembly code and cost model
facts.verdict: verified: 1.25x write, 0.1x read, 5-minute TTL; OpenAI automatic from 1,024 tokens, 1.25x writes on newest models

facts.old: Embedding/retrieval caches for RAG
facts.verdict: carried; Topic: rag-and-retrieval owns depth

facts.old: Limit on TPM as well as RPM; token bucket per tenant per model; concurrency caps for streaming
facts.verdict: verified: Anthropic token bucket quote, ITPM/OTPM; Envoy BackendTrafficPolicy

facts.old: Quota = billing-period budget; rate limits instantaneous; enforce both at gateway; 429 with Retry-After
facts.verdict: verified: RFC 6585, RFC 9110, Envoy QuotaPolicy quote, LiteLLM budgets, Anthropic 429/529 distinction

facts.old: Multi-tenancy models: shared pool with weighted fair queueing, reserved capacity (Bedrock/Azure provisioned throughput), dedicated replicas
facts.verdict: verified VTC (OSDI 2024), SRE criticality, llm-d priority, Anthropic Priority Tier; Bedrock/Azure provisioned throughput not re-checked (dropped as named examples)

facts.old: Cost attribution: usage event per request into stream then OLAP store (ClickHouse); price input/output/cached differently; showback
facts.verdict: carried; ClickHouse not named (generic analytics store)

facts.old: Rollout: offline evals gate, shadow (mirror, discard, compare quality/latency/cost; doubles compute so sample), canary 1-5-25-100% keyed on request or tenant with automated rollback, interleaved/A-B, pin and version everything
facts.verdict: carried; Istio mirror, KServe canaryTrafficPercent, Argo Rollouts analysis verified; statistics owned by Production eval engineering

facts.old: Failure: failover to second provider/region; smaller self-hosted model as deep fallback
facts.verdict: carried

facts.old: Overload: load shedding by priority (batch first, then free tier); admission control; 429 + Retry-After; never queue unboundedly (metastable failure)
facts.verdict: carried; SRE adaptive throttling 2x quote

facts.old: Degradation ladder: full model, cheaper model, truncated context/RAG-off, cached/templated response, honest error; decide in design review
facts.verdict: carried; real policies of GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT free tier, Anthropic added

facts.old: Timeouts per hop with jitter; retry only idempotent calls; cap retries
facts.verdict: carried; depth with sibling Reliability engineering

facts.old: LLM partial failures: mid-stream disconnects, malformed structured output (validate + one retry), context overflow, guardrail trips
facts.verdict: carried; LinkedIn YAML 10% to ~0.01% added

facts.old: Interview structure: requirements, metrics, data, model, serving, monitoring with listed sub-points
facts.verdict: carried, reordered with timings; worked estimate added

facts.old: Frontier-lab interviews: KV cache math, prefill/decode disaggregation, 10x scale
facts.verdict: carried; depth linked to Topic: inference-and-serving
